pairs.input: Explain what HTTP status codes 404 and 500 mean.
pairs.output_a: 404 means the requested resource was not found on the server.
pairs.output_b: 404 means the resource wasn't found on the server; 500 means the server hit an internal error while processing the request.
pairs.expected_output: 404 means resource not found; 500 means internal server error.
